name: ips-urlfilter-cache-setting
help: Configure IPS URL filter cache settings.

dns-retry-interval.name: dns-retry-interval
dns-retry-interval.help: Retry interval. Refresh DNS faster than TTL to capture multiple IPs for hosts. 0 means use DNS server's TTL only.

extended-ttl.name: extended-ttl
extended-ttl.help: Extend time to live beyond reported by DNS. Use of 0 means use DNS server's TTL.
